sentences.text: The Petitioner, who was serving as a Director in the erstwhile Food Research, Ghaziabad, was subsequently absorbed in Respondent No. 2.

By way of the present petition, he impugns the order dated 7th November, 2025, whereby he has been denied In-Situ promotion, allegedly in violation of Section 90 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Counsel for Respondent No. 1 accepts notice.

3. Issue notice to unrepresented Respondents by all permissible modes, upon filing of process fee,
returnable on the next date of hearing.
4.
Upon service, let counter affidavit be filed within a period of six weeks from today.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within a period of four weeks thereafter.

5. Re-notify on 08th July, 2026.
SANJEEV NARULA, J FEBRUARY 5, 2026/ab
